{{Otheruses|Black hole}}
The '''Black Hole''' was a rough-and-tumble [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] on [[The Life]] level of the [[Vergesso Base]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]. 

It was owned by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Djarri]], who, to his dismay, saw his bar becoming a favorite joint for [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] and thugs visiting the station. The clientele however tried to behave knowing that Djarri would call the [[Base Operations Center|Ops]] security otherwise.

The interior of the bar was dark, as the little lighting was focused on the dancers and torch singers on the stage.
